title: Proper support of the algebraization candidate
statement: Under the hypotheses above, let F be a coherent module on Y and suppose its formal completion is isomorphic to the tensor pullback of G. Then F has support proper over Spec A.

proof.text: Identify the support of F with the transported support of the pulled formal system using the completion isomorphism and Nakayama. Pullback preserves the proper support of G and proper q preserves properness; the resulting closed subset is proper over Spec A.

lean.statement:
theorem chow_algebraization_candidate_support
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (I : Ideal A) [IsAdicComplete I A]
    {Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z] (f : Z ⟶ Spec (.of A))
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (Q : Z.IdealSheafData)
    (hQ : Q = (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
      (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv.hom)).comap f)
    (G : CoherentFormalModule Z Q)
    (hR : Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver f (G.obj.obj (op 0)))
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (q : Y ⟶ Z) [IsProper q]
    (F : CoherentModules Y)
    (hF : Nonempty (G.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback q ≅
      formalCompletionSystem (Q.comap q) F.obj)) :
    Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver (q ≫ f) F.obj
